Red letters

An optional way to see the words of Jesus in Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John. KJV only. The choice stays on this device—no account, no tracking.

Here you may read the words of the Lord Jesus in red, exactly as they stand in the King James Version. No added commentary, just His words for weary hearts.

Offline—still got you after your first visit. The toggle below also updates search, reader, plans, and the heritage tree when those pages load.

Show words of Jesus in red

Applies in the four Gospels across search, reader, plans, coloring, and One Family in Christ. You can also switch it from Home → footer Appearance.

Only His voice — five-day plan

Sometimes the kindest thing is to silence every other voice and listen to the Lord Jesus Himself. Only His Voice is a pure Red-Letters path—just the words Jesus spoke in the KJV. No commentary. No other voices. Print all five when paper helps. Turn on the toggle above so His words show in red across the site.

Sample verses

Turn the toggle on to see Christ’s speech marked in red. Narration stays in the default color.

    When words fail

    When your own prayers feel empty, start with Only His Voice—only the Saviour’s speech—or walk Come Unto Me for five quiet days (KJV). Print Only His Voice or Come Unto Me when paper helps.

    When fear presses in

    When fear speaks louder than reason, walk When Fear Presses In—gentle Scripture for anxious days, His voice and sure promises. Print all five when paper helps. For pure red letters only, rest in Only His Voice. Pairs with Come Unto Me when weariness and fear share the same hour.

    The gospel path

    Wondering how a sinner can be made right with God? The Road to Salvation walks five quiet KJV days—no test at the end, only an open invitation. Print all five when paper helps.
